items.title: Amazon RDS now supports per snapshot billing
items.content_snippet: Starting today, Amazon RDS supports per snapshot billing for Amazon RDS snapshots. Per snapshot billing allows you to get the cost of each individual snapshot. Previously, RDS snapshot charges were aggregated at the database instance level on the Cost and Usage report as well as the Cost Explorer. This meant that while understanding the snapshot charges, you could only see the aggregate view at the database instance instead of drilling down to each individual snapshot. items.title: Amazon Quick on desktop now uses your organization's existing Amazon Quick sign-in
items.content_snippet: For organizations that use Amazon Quick, the desktop application now signs users in with the same sign-in method the organization already uses for Quick on the web. Administrators no longer need to register an OIDC application in their identity provider or set up separate desktop sign-in before users can get started.
